en: Welcome to my abode. What's up, guys?
zh: 欢迎来到我的住处。大家好吗？

en: Welcome to, if I may say so, a long awaited apartment tour.
zh: 欢迎来看这期——容我这么说——让大家久等了的公寓参观。

en: We are here in Brooklyn.
zh: 我们现在在布鲁克林。

en: This is two bed, two bath.
zh: 这是两室两卫。

en: I've taken a while to get it in a livable, homey place
zh: 我花了挺长时间，才把这里收拾成一个适合居住、很有家的感觉的样子，

en: where I feel comfortable showing it to you guys.
zh: 让我觉得可以很自在地带你们看看。

en: I've lived here for six months, so it's been a minute.
zh: 我已经在这儿住了六个月了，所以也住了一阵子了。

en: Without further ado, let's start off where the magic happens, the kitchen.
zh: 闲话不多说，我们就从最有魔力发生的地方开始——厨房。

en: Architectural Digest. Great. First thing I guess I'd like to point out,
zh: 《建筑文摘》风。不错。首先我想说的是，

en: we have an induction stovetop.
zh: 我们这里是电磁炉灶台。

en: The first that I've ever had.
zh: 这是我第一次用这种。

en: And I made the mistake of bringing over my old pots and pans.
zh: 而我还犯了个错，把以前的锅碗瓢盆都搬过来了。

en: They don't work on induction.
zh: 它们不能在电磁炉上用。

en: You have to have induction grade pans.
zh: 你得用适配电磁炉的锅具才行。

en: Come over here, we have some fun little details.
zh: 来这边看看，我们这儿有一些很有意思的小细节。

en: It's our salt. It's our...
zh: 这是我们的盐。这是我们的……

en: Oop! Oop! I just think this is the cutest little container.
zh: 哦！哦！我真的觉得这个小容器也太可爱了。

en: I got this recently. Actually, both of these.
zh: 这是我最近买的。其实这两个都是。

en: We have a really cute kitchenware store near us, and that's where I got these things.
zh: 我们家附近有一家特别可爱的厨具店，这些东西就是在那里买的。

en: It's pretty adult, if you ask me, a spoon rest.
zh: 要我说，这可太有成年人的感觉了——锅铲托。

en: Come on. For the first like five months of living here, I just,
zh: 拜托。刚搬进来前五个月左右的时候，我就只是——

en: we just put it here and had to clean it every time.
zh: 我们就直接把它放这儿，每次都得擦干净。

en: It also matches pretty well.
zh: 而且它跟整体也挺搭的。

en: Okay. Come on over here.
zh: 好了。来这边。

en: Sink. Farmhouse variety. I know you guys are thinking about it, right?
zh: 水槽。农舍风的那种。我知道你们肯定已经注意到了，对吧？

en: Like this thing, $46 for hand soap.
zh: 比如这个，洗手液要46美元。

en: Taylor, you're not in reality anymore.
zh: Taylor，你已经脱离现实了。

en: You guys should know we had a really awesome sub letter who's a friend of mine.
zh: 你们得知道，我们之前有一位特别棒的短租房客，她也是我的朋友。

en: She came and stayed for a few weeks and left a few things behind.
zh: 她来住了几周，走的时候留下了一些东西。

en: that she thought we could use the Aesop soap being one of them.
zh: 她觉得我们可能用得上，Aesop 洗手液就是其中之一。

en: So very nice. Thank you.
zh: 真的太贴心了。谢谢你。

en: Gabby. Gabby's her name. She's great.
zh: Gabby。她叫 Gabby。她人特别好。

en: Okay. Moving over here, we have my favorite food of all time.
zh: 好，看到这边，这里是我这辈子最喜欢吃的东西。

en: I like to have a constant supply just to be eaten whenever I want.
zh: 我喜欢一直备着，想吃的时候随时都能吃。

en: Moving over here, you guys, PSA lilies are extremely toxic to cats.
zh: 再看这边，给大家一个提醒：百合花对猫是剧毒。

en: Not going to go into too much detail on how I know that,
zh: 至于我是怎么知道的，我就不展开细说了，

en: but let's just say I was very recently in an emergency vet clinic
zh: 只能说，就在最近，我还去了急诊宠物医院，

en: when I was supposed to be at a wedding last weekend.
zh: 而那会儿我本来上周末应该去参加婚礼的。

en: So don't buy lilies if you have cats.
zh: 所以家里有猫的话，千万别买百合。

en: We don't have cats though.
zh: 不过我们没有猫。

en: So not a problem. Moving over here.
zh: 所以没事。继续看这边。

en: You might think this is just a really, really large, nice built-in pantry for our dry goods,
zh: 你可能会以为，这只是一个特别大、特别好看的嵌入式食品储藏柜，用来放干货、

en: cereal and such. Wrong! My oh, I didn't even say I live here with a roommate.
zh: 麦片之类的。错啦！天哪，我都还没说我其实是和室友一起住的。

en: I live here with one other roommate and we eat pretty much the same exact thing.
zh: 我和另一位室友住在这里，而且我们吃的东西几乎一模一样。

en: So we have zero percent fat, 19 gram protein Greek yogurt on tap.
zh: 所以我们这里常备零脂、19克蛋白的希腊酸奶，随时都有。

en: This makes me laugh. You know that viral feta tomato recipe.
zh: 这个真的把我逗笑了。你们知道那个很火的菲达奶酪番茄食谱吧。

en: we made that the other night?
zh: 我们前几天晚上做了那个。

en: Tasty, but it looks so disgusting.
zh: 味道是挺好，但看起来真的很恶心。

en: Like it looks like coagulated rotten, but it tastes good.
zh: 就是看着像那种凝固了的腐烂东西，但吃起来还不错。

en: Just wanted to throw that out there.
zh: 就是顺便提一嘴。

en: We have these bowls, which I've always wanted kind of like a heavy stoneware
zh: 我们有这些碗，我一直都很想要这种有分量感的粗陶餐具，

en: that you can't see. That's where they're from.
zh: 你们看不到。它们就是从那里买的。

en: They're from Castler. Fenicia Diner.
zh: 是 Castler。Fenicia Diner。

en: That's a place that my roommate and I went to for Valentine's Day one year
zh: 那是有一年情人节时，我和室友一起去的一家店，

en: because it was probably one of the best cinnamon rolls we've ever had
zh: 因为那大概是我们吃过最好吃的肉桂卷之一，

en: and I wanted to commemorate it.
zh: 我想用这个留作纪念。

en: Tea for Turtle. Real ones know.
zh: Tea for Turtle。老粉都懂。

en: Huntsman. That's the program I was in in college.
zh: Huntsman。那是我大学时读的项目。

en: Moving here. A friend of mine, his dad actually handcrafted this in Canada.
zh: 看到这边，这个其实是我一个朋友的爸爸在加拿大手工做的。

en: I just think it's really pretty to look at.
zh: 我就是觉得它摆在那里特别好看。

en: I will link his website down below as well if you guys want to check those out.
zh: 如果你们也想看看，我会把他的网站链接放在下方。
